runner: run_lerobot_libero.py (LeRobot policy, processors, LIBERO env and rollout loop)
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: LeRobot port (lerobot org) of 2toINF/X-VLA-Libero, run with the flags of LeRobot's xvla docs: absolute EE control, episode_length 800 for every suite; checkpoint settings chunk 30 / n_action_steps 30, domain_id 3; LeRobot's 360 px observations, resized by the X-VLA processor. The original X-VLA LIBERO client differs: 256 px cameras, horizons 800/800/800/900, the predicted EE pose fed back as proprio (the port feeds the observed state), seed 42+episode+100. Seed 1000+init here instead of the docs' 142. Tokenizer facebook/bart-large read from a local folder.
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
